name: sundering-moon-enter-with-two-wind-allies-gets-plus-one-power
notes: Sundering Moon [Jin Bonus] On Enter: two wind allies give it +1 power until end of turn. Pre-fix SunderingMoonEnterResolve read an ambient 'currentMZID' that was never stored, so the power was never granted.

rulesClauses: [Jin Bonus] On Enter: If you control two or more wind element allies, CARDNAME gets +1 [POWER] until end of turn.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. SunderingMoonEnterResolve() looked the entering weapon up through GetVariable("currentMZID"), which nothing ever stores, so it returned early. It now uses the enter ability's "mzID" macro parameter.
